subject: Unable to show dynamic content from a module in a sidebarMenu in shinydashboard

messages.author: 1200926c1d8c4eb2
messages.subject: Unable to show dynamic content from a module in a sidebarMenu in shinydashboard
parts:
Hello,

I am trying without success to show the uiOutput of a module as a subitem in a sidebarMenu menuItem.

In the code example below, the module renders correctly in the body but not in the sidebar menuItem.

I suspect that the callModule function is not being triggered but I have no idea how to do it. I appreciate your suggestions.


Code Example:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

dynamicTextUI <- function(id){
  ns <- NS(id)
  uiOutput(ns("dynText"))
}

dynamicText <- function(input, output, session){
  output$dynText <- renderText(format(Sys.time(), "%a %b %d %X %Y"))
}

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(),
  
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Menu Item", tabName = "mitem", dynamicTextUI("dynamicsubmenu"))
    )),
  
  dashboardBody(
    dynamicTextUI("dynamicbody")
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  callModule(dynamicText, "dynamicsubmenu")
  callModule(dynamicText, "dynamicbody")
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Unable to show dynamic content from a module in a sidebarMenu in shinydashboard
parts:
This is a bug in shinydashboard. Shiny doesn't render outputs that it doesn't think are visible. In this case, it sees that the sidebar copy of uiOutput isn't visible, so it doesn't run the renderUI. The bug is that whenever that visibility changes, the JS is supposed to let Shiny know by doing a $(document).trigger("shown") (or "hidden") but shinydashboard appears not to be doing that.

You can work around this for now by adding below this line inside of the dynamicText function:

outputOptions(output, "dynText", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

And we'll file an issue on shinydashboard to get this fixed, if there isn't one already. Thanks!
